record.viewport: 744 CSS px wide iPad portrait, dark mode
record.summary: Apart from the accepted deviations, the render matches the frame except for one small difference: the Inbox rows are packed 2 px tighter, so the To review group and the bottom of the panel sit 6 px higher.

findings.reference_location: Inbox panel, the three rows starting at y 383, 441 and 499, with To review at y 563
findings.reference_shows: the rows are 58 px apart (title baselines at about 383, 441 and 499), and To review is 64 px below the last row
findings.render_location: Inbox panel, the three rows starting at y 383, 439 and 495, with To review at y 557
findings.render_shows: the rows are 56 px apart (about 383, 439 and 495), and To review is 62 px below the last row, so the panel ends 6 px higher (585 against 591)

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panels. The Overview tab shows the Inbox, Queue and Context drift panels (R5, R6, R9) and no Chats panel: that is NCC-130's next PR (Chats, with its pager; LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: The render ends after Context drift. It has no Chats heading, search, filter chips, table or pager.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Context drift. ncc check gives one line of text for each finding, with no repository and no kind, so the panel has a row for each finding (3 here) where the frame groups 22 findings by repository with a count and a chevron. The line over the rows says when the check ran and what it reads ("Checked 12m ago. Folder layout and hooks."), where the frame has a clock time and other checks ("AGENTS.md length, links and folder layout"), which wait for a later check. The heading is PageHeader at its pane size, as Inbox and Queue are.
accepted_deviations.note: There are three one-line rows with no count or chevron, the heading count is 3, and the line reads "Checked 12m ago. Folder layout and hooks." Every row fits on one line, and none is cut off.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Queue. "In progress" lists the open PRs with their pills, and no priority mark or owner chat on a row ("the-bridge#535" without "· bridge-workbench"): both come from Linear, which is out of scope. There is no "Up next" group, so the Queue counts its open PRs: 3 where the frame says 8, and "In progress" 3 where the frame says 4 over three rows.
accepted_deviations.note: The rows have no priority bars, so the titles start at x 60 where the frame has 86. This follows from the missing mark. The pills match the frame.

accepted_deviations.as_given: To review. The group shows as the frame draws it, closed with 17. On the live page it is empty until backend-coord decides how a chat's Inbox item names its project.
Panel headings. "Inbox" and "Queue" are PageHeader at its pane size (15 px, the count in mono), where the frame has an 18/24 heading and a 13 px count: no text style is 18 px (LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: The headings are smaller, and the panel below each one starts about 2 to 3 px further from it. This follows from the heading size.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panel gap. One panel over the other, they are 24 apart where the frame has 28, which no spacing token has (LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: From each panel's bottom to the next heading is 4 px less than in the frame.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tabs. The tab row shows Overview, Repositories, QA and Ideas, where the frame shows Overview, Repositories, Architecture and QA: only the tabs of shipped increments show (d-133). Repositories is increment two's live slice, QA increment three's and Ideas increment one's. So QA sits where the frame draws Architecture, and Ideas where it draws QA.
accepted_deviations.note: The tabs read Overview, Repositories, QA (play icon) and Ideas (bulb icon), and Overview is selected as in the frame.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Quick chat shows as the frame draws it; no frame draws its composer, so it is the library Dialog on every size, and in a state it opens nothing.
accepted_deviations.note: The button matches the frame in size, icon and colour.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Owner's name. NCC-1701's purpose starts "The owner's personal workspace", where the frame has the owner's name: the secret scan's personal-term rule keeps the name out of web/, so the purpose breaks its lines at other words. The live page shows the brain's own words.
accepted_deviations.note: The purpose stays two lines and breaks after "directing AI".

accepted_deviations.as_given: Top. The back row with Quick chat sits 4 px higher than the frame's: the page starts 24 down, where the frame has 28, which no spacing token has. The tabs are 2 px lower than the frame's.
accepted_deviations.note: The back row is at about y 41 where the frame has 45, and the tabs are at about 208 where the frame has 206.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Picture. The picture is 64 px square, as on T01b and D01, where this frame draws 56, which no size token has (LIBRARY_GAPS.md, Project picture 56). The name and the purpose keep the frame's 16 px gap, so they start 8 px right of the frame's.
accepted_deviations.note: The picture spans x 32 to 96 and y 84 to 148, and the name starts at x 112 where the frame has 104.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tab bar. The tab bar is the app's shared one in the default order (d-105): Home, Inbox, Workspaces, Projects, Artifacts and More. The frame draws Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More.
accepted_deviations.note: The tab bar has six items, and Projects is selected.

limits: The reference is a PNG, so differences of 1 px or less in text position and glyph rendering could not be told apart reliably.
Very slight tone differences between the dark panel backgrounds and borders could not be checked with confidence.
The Chats region could not be compared because the render leaves it out (accepted deviation A1).
